initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 24/30 − 72/120 = 0.20. Arithmetic verification does not establish causal identification. Request archived design record R132-1 to assess whether the causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R132-1 establishes assignment independent of both potential outcomes, full compliance, positivity, consistency, and no interference. Therefore the causal risk difference equals the exact population contrast: 24/30 − 72/120 = 0.20.
